summary: This change adds published apps: control-plane AppStore and AppService, owner-side publication markers, idempotent app VM installs, owner RPCs, and the `halo app` CLI. The three round-1 findings are fixed. Action addresses now accept the `tools.` prefix (fixed in the base, #471). Cancel now treats an app VM that does not answer as not installed. Abandoning a publication now deletes the app VM through the new `provider.remove`. All test runs pass. The only remaining blocker is the coverage gate: one changed line, the type-only `remove?` member in WorkspaceProviderApi.ts:75, has neither coverage nor an exemption.

findings.body: The coverage gate fails on this line. The coverage report lists the new optional interface member `remove?` as an uncovered executable line, and no test loads the file. It is a type-only declaration, like `hostsSharedApps` at line 43, which already has a `coverage-exempt` comment. Add the same kind of exemption with a reason, for example: "Type-only optional provider operation, called by AppService.abandon and implemented by ExeWorkspaceProvider.remove". This lets the gate pass.
